The '''Shaman Caves''' are the upper floor of a cave system located in the [[Kharazi Jungle]] in southern [[Karamja]]. They play a large role in [[Legends' Quest]], which must be started in order to access the caves. The entrance to the cave is in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle and is accessed by squeezing into the [[mossy rock]], which requires 50 [[Agility]].

The first room of the caves has a [[fire wall]] containing [[Ungadulu]], a shaman possessed by the black demon [[Nezikchened]]. Ungadulu later helps the player reach the deeper sections of the cave, including the deeper [[Viyeldi caves]] accessed via a [[Winch (Viyeldi caves)|winch]] at the end of the dungeon. There is a shortcut on the western wall near the entrance that bypasses a majority of the cave, requiring 96 [[Agility]].

After Legends' Quest, there are two reasons to return to the caves:
* A hard task for the [[Karamja Diary]] (kill a [[death wing]])
* A [[Clue scroll (master) - If you're feeling brave, dig beneath the dragon's eye|master clue step]]

==History==
The origins of the caves are unknown, but they contain the source of the pure water that can be collected from the [[Water Pool]] in the [[Kharazi Jungle]]. Many died exploring the caves trying to find the source of the water, which resulted in them becoming cursed to guard the source as spirits.{{CiteNPC|npc=Gujuo|quote=The legends say they died trying to find the source of the sacred water, and now they are cursed to guard it for all eternity.|loc=Legends' Quest|notes=|name=}} [[Viyeldi]] was a sorcerer and the first to die in search of the source, resulting in the cave system being named after him, and causing a stranger magic to linger within which inflicts terror in all who venture near.{{CiteNPC|npc=Gujuo|quote=The first to die was a powerful sorcerer, and his strange magic lingers in the cave. Now all who venture near are struck by terror, and cannot proceed.|loc=Legends' Quest|notes=|name=}}

Others would attempt to find the source, such as the warriors [[San Tojalon]], [[Irvig Senay]], and [[Ranalph Devere]], whose spirits are controlled by Viyeldi.{{CiteNPC|npc=Ungadulu|quote=Viyeldi was the spirit of a powerful sorcerer, who controlled the spirits of those bound to the sacred water.|loc=Legends' Quest|notes=|name=}} At some point over a hundred years ago, an expedition of [[dwarf (race)|dwarves]] ventured into the caves to try to find the source, but never returned.{{CiteNPC|npc=Ungadulu|quote=My great-grandfather told me he once even saw an expedition of dwarves down there! Something terrible must have happened to them, because they never returned.|loc=Legends' Quest|notes=|name=}} A [[Buried skeleton (Shaman Caves)|dwarven skeleton]] holding a pickaxe can be found in the Shaman Caves, and [[barrel (Shaman Caves)|barrels]] full of supplies as well as a [[winch (Shaman Caves)|winch]] leading into the [[Viyeldi caves]] can be found at the end of the Shaman Caves, likely having been left by the dwarves.

==Transportation==
To navigate the caves after the quest (below 96 Agility), bring the following items: 
{{Checklist|
* A [[pickaxe]],
* A [[lockpick]],
* An [[unpowered orb]],
* Runes to cast an [[enchantment]] spell (3 [[cosmic rune]]s and 30 elemental runes).
* An [[axe]] and [[machete]] to access the Kharazi Jungle, unless using the level 79 Agility [[Vine (Kharazi Jungle)|shortcut]].
* A [[spade]], if doing a [[master clue scroll]].
}}

The unpowered orb, runes, and a spade are not required to access the [[Death wing|Death Wings]].

To traverse the caves, the following steps must be taken:

# Enter the caves by searching the Rocks in the north-western part of the Kharazi Jungle.
#* If you have at least 96 Agility and have completed Legends' Quest, use the shortcut on the western wall near the entrance of the cave. Skip to step 9.
# Search the [[Bookcase (Viyeldi caves)|eastern bookcase]].
# Use a lockpick (note: a [[strange old lockpick]] will not work) on the [[Ancient Gate]] (click out of the dialogue if it states your lockpick breaks and try again)
# Smash the three boulders. (Level 52 mining require to smash boulders).
# Open the next Ancient Gate. (Level 50 strength require to attempt to move the metal doors).
# Jump-over the [[jagged wall]].
# 'Use' the Marked wall on the west side of the room.
# Manually cast any [[Charge Orb]] spell on the northern Ancient Gate.
# Search, then Climb-down the winch.
# Climb-over several rocky ledges, or use the long rope shortcut (with 91 [[Agility]]).
